## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Security, performance, or deployment change

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test -- --run`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` (or explain why not applicable)

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] Tests or documented manual verification cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Keyboard, touch, responsive, and accessibility behavior were considered.
- [ ] LocalStorage/imported data remains validated and no private data is included.
- [ ] PWA/offline behavior was checked when relevant.
- [ ] Performance, security, and deployment implications are documented when relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, or Terraform state are committed.
- [ ] User-facing documentation was updated when commands or behavior changed.
